summary.caption: An ornate anime illustration in hikkikomori17 style depicts a theatrical doll-like girl with long dark espresso wavy hair and warm amber-rose eyes dancing gracefully on a velvet stage. Crowning her curls is an oversized crimson-and-gold harlequin diamond-print headbow trimmed with antique ivory lace and pearl drop pins. She wears a boned deep crimson crushed-velvet corset bodice featuring a diamond-patterned center panel, a gilded heart brooch, multi-strand pearl chains, and gathered off-shoulder puff sleeves with ruffled lace cuffs. Her sweeping open-front crimson velvet ballgown overskirt flares wide to reveal voluminous tiered cream-and-gold harlequin petticoats printed with vintage storybook bears, paired with diamond-patterned stockings and bow-adorned mary jane heels. Floating beside her outstretched left hand is a whimsical stitched plush jester doll wearing a tiny pointed cone hat, framed within a delicate antique gold floral filigree border.

summary.caption: A painterly anime-style illustration portrays an ethereal fox-spirit maiden with silver-blush updo hair, heterochromatic golden-and-jade eyes, and plush white fox ears standing amidst drifting red lotus petals. Adorning her hair are ruby-enameled lotus hairpins and gold filigree sticks, while a delicate multi-strand crystal-and-pearl face veil drapes across her nose and lips. She wears an intricate cloisonne enamel butterfly-shaped chest bodice in shimmering vermilion, gold, and turquoise, tied beneath the bust with a royal cornflower-blue silk ribbon bow, framed by sculptural blooming red lotus shoulder pads and sheer coral organza petal sleeves. Her floor-length ombre vermilion-and-cream pleated silk skirt cascades in lotus-petal tiers with gilded cloud brocade and beaded tassels, while her right hand clad in sharp gilded fingertip armor holds a pleated red folding fan.

summary.caption: A vibrant and ornate pastel anime illustration in yume335 style depicts a dreamy fairy princess with soft lavender spiral curls and sparkling sapphire eyes floating gently in a starlit meadow. Her stiffened pastel-pink satin corset bodice gleams with golden sunburst embroidery, off-shoulder ruffled organza petal sleeves, and iridescent fairy wings unfurling from her back. Below her cinched waist blooms a massive crinoline ballgown of prismatic pink-and-lavender pleated satin overlaid with scalloped lace peplums and golden starlight motifs, while her raised right hand waves a crystal snowflake star wand framed by delicate white Victorian filigree.
